title: verse.bridge/1
description: Frozen message schemas of docs/verse/unreal/contracts/bridge-protocol.md. 'x-messages' lists every message type with its direction, kind, topic and the $defs entries of its frame, data and (commands) reply result. 'x-fallback' on an enum names the value a reader uses for an unknown one. Golden data must match exactly (no unknown fields or values); live readers ignore unknown fields and map unknown enum values to their fallback.

x-kinds.handshake: hello (first Verse frame, no id) and welcome (seq 1)
x-kinds.command: Verse to server, carries id, answered by exactly one reply whose re is that id
x-kinds.notice: Verse to server, no id, no reply
x-kinds.feed: Server to Verse on a topic; snapshot first, deltas carry base
x-kinds.reply: Server to Verse, answers one command

screens.frame.x-note: Only kind delta carries base; a snapshot does not.
